CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE sis_subject_map AS
SELECT DISTINCT
  LOWER(TRIM(subject_code)) AS subject_code,
  TRIM(department_code) AS department_code,
  TRIM(department_name) AS department_name,
  TRIM(school_code) AS school_code,
  TRIM(school_name) AS school_name

WHERE subject_code IS NOT NULL

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE subject_offered AS
WITH base AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    term_code,
    subject_id,
    offer_dept_code,
    offer_dept_name,
    offer_school_name
  FROM beaver.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED

  SELECT
    term_code,
    subject_id,
    UPPER(subject_id) AS subject_id_up,
    offer_dept_code,
    offer_dept_name,
    offer_school_name,
    /* parse subject_code and subject_number from subject_id like '6.370' */
    LOWER(SPLIT_PART(subject_id, '.', 1)) AS subject_code,
    SPLIT_PART(subject_id, '.', 2) AS subject_number
  FROM base
)
SELECT
  term_code,
  subject_id,
  LOWER(TRIM(subject_code)) AS subject_code,
  TRIM(subject_number) AS subject_number,
  TRIM(offer_dept_code) AS offer_dept_code,
  TRIM(offer_dept_name) AS offer_dept_name,

FROM parsed

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH base AS (
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(ssm.school_code, dd.school_code) AS school_code,
        COALESCE(ssm.school_name, dd.school_name, so.offer_school_name) AS school_name,
        COALESCE(dd.department_full_name, dd.department_name, so.offer_dept_name, scd.department_name) AS department_full_name,
        scd.course_level AS course_level,
        scd.is_degree_granting AS is_degree_granting
    FROM subject_offered so
    LEFT JOIN sis_subject_map ssm ON LOWER(ssm.subject_code) = LOWER(so.subject_code)
    LEFT JOIN department_directory dd ON dd.department_code = COALESCE(ssm.department_code, so.offer_dept_code)
    LEFT JOIN sis_course_description scd ON LOWER(scd.course) = LOWER(so.subject_code || '.' || so.subject_number)
)
SELECT 
    school_code,
    school_name,
    department_full_name,
    course_level,
    COUNT(*) AS total_courses,
    SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(is_degree_granting,'N')) IN ('Y','YES','1','T','TRUE') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_degree_granting_courses
FROM base
WHERE school_code IS NOT NULL AND department_full_name IS NOT NULL AND course_level IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4
ORDER BY school_code, department_full_name, course_level
LIMIT 200

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH so AS (
  SELECT 
    lower(coalesce(subject_code,'')) AS subject_code,
    subject_number,
    coalesce(offer_dept_code, department_code) AS offer_dept_code,
    coalesce(offer_dept_name, department_name) AS offer_dept_name,
    coalesce(offer_school_name, '') AS offer_school_name
  FROM subject_offered
),
code_map AS (
  SELECT lower(subject_code) AS subject_code,
         department_code,
         department_name,
         school_code,
         school_name
  FROM sis_subject_code
),
-- derive course key like '6.002' from so to try exact match to sis_course_description.course
so_course_key AS (
  SELECT 
    s.subject_code,
    s.subject_number,
    (s.subject_code || '.' || s.subject_number) AS course_key,
    cm.department_code,
    coalesce(cm.department_name, s.offer_dept_name) AS department_name,
    cm.school_code,
    coalesce(cm.school_name, s.offer_school_name) AS school_name
  FROM so s
  LEFT JOIN code_map cm USING(subject_code)
),
scd_by_course AS (
  SELECT lower(course) AS course_key,
         course_level,
         is_degree_granting,
         department_name
  FROM sis_course_description
),
scd_by_prefix AS (
  SELECT lower(course) AS course_key,
         split_part(lower(course),' ',1) AS subject_prefix, -- handles forms like '11 NIV'
         course_level,
         is_degree_granting
  FROM sis_course_description
),
joined AS (
  SELECT 
    sk.school_code,
    sk.school_name,
    sk.department_name,
    coalesce(scdc.course_level, scdp.course_level) AS course_level,
    coalesce(scdc.is_degree_granting, scdp.is_degree_granting) AS is_degree_granting,
    sk.subject_code,
    sk.subject_number
  FROM so_course_key sk
  LEFT JOIN scd_by_course scdc ON lower(scdc.course_key) = lower(sk.course_key)
  LEFT JOIN scd_by_prefix scdp ON scdp.subject_prefix = sk.subject_code
),
-- heuristic fallback for course_level when missing: subject_number < 500 -> U, else G
final_base AS (
  SELECT 
    school_code,
    school_name,
    department_name AS department_full_name,
    CASE 
      WHEN coalesce(course_level,'') <> '' THEN course_level
      ELSE CASE WHEN try_cast(subject_number AS DOUBLE) < 500 THEN 'U' ELSE 'G' END
    END AS course_level,
    CASE 
      WHEN upper(coalesce(is_degree_granting,'')) IN ('Y','YES','1','T','TRUE') THEN 'Y' 
      WHEN upper(coalesce(is_degree_granting,'')) IN ('N','NO','0','F','FALSE') THEN 'N'
      ELSE 'N'
    END AS is_degree_granting
  FROM joined
  WHERE school_code IS NOT NULL AND department_full_name IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  school_code,
  school_name,
  department_full_name,
  course_level,
  COUNT(*) AS total_courses,
  SUM(CASE WHEN is_degree_granting = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_degree_granting_courses
FROM final_base
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4
ORDER BY school_code, department_full_name, course_level
LIMIT 200
